summary_md: **Simon Willison ([@simonw](https://x.com/simonw/status/2115821668350435645))** calls a write-up on building a multiplayer game world with autonomous Fable-class models a sharp-edge case study of agentic engineering, then tries **Spawn** on his phone, prompting a castle and a dragon into existence via its in-game chatbot, with more notes on his blog ([Spawn](https://www.spawn.co/), [blog post](https://simonwillison.net/2026/Oct/29/how-i-built-the-most-ai-pilled-company-in-the-world/)).

referenced_urls.title: Spawn: Your Place to Make Games with Friends
Building a multiplayer game world with autonomous Fable-class models

relevance: Real-world agentic game creation and engineering lessons.

media.description: Mobile voxel-style 3D game: first-person view from a dragon's saddle flying near a castle.
Same game with the chat panel open over the castle scene, showing prompts to resize and land the dragon.
